subject: Air-gapped release: image signing cadence, handoff, and rollback runbook
messages:
From: Paul Mendoza <paul.m@secupartners.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@atlasedge.com
Date: 2027-09-28T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Preparing Oct window for sealed-site bundle + signer rotation

Hi Vanessa,

We have an upcoming maintenance window the week of Oct 4 for our sealed cluster fleet. Before we lock dates with facilities, we need a concise handoff for:
- exact artifact checksums we should expect (manifest format)
- signer rotation process and expected outage (if any)
- abort/rollback criteria and who to call for emergency unsigned rollback

Can Redwood provide a short runbook and the signed-bundle manifest we should verify on arrival? We also need to confirm HSM usage during acceptance.

Thanks,
Paul
AtlasEdge – Platform Ops
[attachment: atlas-request-20270928.pdf (28KB)]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Mendoza <paul.m@secupartners.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, ops@atlasedge.com
Date: 2027-09-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preparing Oct window for sealed-site bundle + signer rotation

Paul —

Thanks for the heads up. I attached a concise runbook and a sample signed manifest for your acceptance test. High level:

1) Manifest format: JSON manifest with bundle_id, sha256 digests per image, signer_key_id, timestamp, signature (Ed25519). We will provide the manifest and the public verification key for your acceptance.
2) Signer rotation: We perform signer key rotation in two phases. Phase A (pre-deploy): Redwood signs a new bundle and publishes an ORIGIN token. Phase B (on-site acceptance): AtlasEdge verifies both old and new signer fingerprints before switching verification to the new key. No downtime required for verification; actual image swap window is 10–15 minutes per cluster if KV caches need to be purged.
3) Rollback: If post-install checks fail (checksum mismatch, boot failures in more than 2/5 pilot nodes, or health checks not passing after 30 minutes), we advise automatic rollback to last-known-good bundle (manifest included). The rollback is a signed unsigned-bundle action documented in the runbook.

Attached: redwood-release-runbook-v1.3.md, signed-bundle-manifest-20270927.json (sample).

We use an HSM-backed KMS for the signing key. If you need a hardware attestation flow on your side, we can provide a short checklist for cross-checking the public key fingerprint in your secure enclave.

Let me know how detailed you want the on-site acceptance checklist. If acceptable, Karthik can prepare a one-page condensed checklist for facilities.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-release-runbook-v1.3.md (14KB)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Mendoza <paul.m@secupartners.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-29T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preparing Oct window for sealed-site bundle + signer rotation

Paul / Vanessa —

Quick questions from the compliance side before the runbook is finalized: 
- Does the manifest include signer_key_id + KMS key rotation history (yes/no)?
- Can AtlasEdge capture the signing timestamp and include it in your audit snapshot? (We ask because our SOC auditor will want a tamper-evident timeline.)

Also please confirm whether the acceptance flow requires AtlasEdge to upload verification results back to Redwood or only retain them locally. If the latter, include a retention policy suggestion.

Marissa
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
From: Paul Mendoza <paul.m@secupartners.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@atlasedge.com
Date: 2027-09-30T14:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preparing Oct window for sealed-site bundle + signer rotation

Marissa —

Thanks. Manifest we received already includes signer_key_id and a simple rotation array; we'll need the rotation history format spelled out (which keys were active and time windows). We will capture the signing timestamp in our audit logs — preferred retention is 7 years but we can start with 2 years if needed.

We prefer to retain verification artefacts locally (air-gapped evidence vault). However, for faster remediation we'd like an option to upload (SFTP) a minimal verification envelope to Redwood for post-acceptance troubleshooting if we opt in.

Paul
AtlasEdge Ops
[attachment: acceptance-window-preferences.xlsx (9KB)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Mendoza <paul.m@secupartners.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-02T10:33:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated handoff checklist + emergency rollback contacts (draft)

Team —

I put together a condensed handoff we suggest for the sealed-site tech lead. It's attached as the one-page checklist and includes:
- pre-shipment checks (manifest, key fingerprints)
- site acceptance steps (verify manifest, run verification tool, validate node health)
- throttled rollout pattern (pilot 3 nodes, then 10, then full)
- abort criteria and rollback commands
- emergency contacts (on-call infra + security) with PGP and OOB phone numbers

If AtlasEdge is comfortable with the SFTP envelope option, the runbook includes the minimal file spec (manifest, verification-summary.json, verifier.log.gz). By default, retention is local only; the SFTP upload is opt-in and uses mutual TLS + client certs.

Attached: handoff-checklist.pdf, emergency-contacts.vcf

Karthik
Principal Site Reliability Architect
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Mendoza <paul.m@secupartners.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated handoff checklist + emergency rollback contacts (draft)

Paul —

This looks good to proceed. Two final notes: 
1) We will publish the final signed manifest for the Oct 4 window on Oct 3 at 17:00 UTC. The public key fingerprint is: ed25519:3b7a...f9c4 (short). Please verify fingerprints using the included KMS attestation doc.
2) We set a conservative pilot window of 45 minutes with an automatic rollback script that will revert to bundle v20270915 if any pilot node fails health checks. Karthik, please confirm the rollback CLI snippet we tested earlier is in the runbook (it's in the attached final).

Assuming no objections, I'll upload the final runbook and the signed-bundle-manifest to the Drive link and send you the passphrase for the handoff container via separate channel.

Thanks all — see you in the window.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
